title: Hold a meat processing licence
what: Process meat for sale for human consumption only under a licence (or as a retailer using meat from a licensed supplier).

sources.title: Meat Industries Act 1996 (NT)
sources.quote: A person shall not process meat for human consumption that is to be sold: (a) except under a licence;

reach.condition: if it slaughters animals or processes meat for sale for human consumption
